Fantastic for families!
Jul 2026 • Family
Beautiful food for all our family. Ranging from myself (Chef of 30 years, business owner in the UK, Catering manger for contract catering company), my wife who is gluten intolerant, my son who loves spice, daughter 1 who doesn't love spice but loves aromatic flavours and daughter 2 who is much younger and sticks to what she knows. 
We went as a party of 10, nothing was too much trouble, the place was packed and the food and drinks were served by the lovely family who run the restaurant. 
I even got a demonstration on how to roll my bánh xèo (a crispy Vietnamese pancake stuffed with shrimp and veg) which was dipped in a peanut sauce that was absolutely delicious!
It was so good I went by myself the following day for lunch, Beef Pho.
